name: rawnd
description: Open camera RAW photos in the conversation, read on the user's device and never uploaded, and give them a hand-written look.

interface.longDescription:
Rawnd opens camera RAW photos inside the conversation. ChatGPT reads JPEG, PNG, WebP and GIF; a NEF, CR3, ARW or RAF file shows it nothing. Rawnd adds a panel where you drop the RAW file. The file is read on your device, inside the panel, and never uploaded: not to Rawnd, not to OpenAI.

What it does
- Shows the JPEG the camera stored inside the RAW file, in under a second, with the shooting data: camera, lens, shutter speed, aperture, ISO and focal length.
- Lets you keep that JPEG (right-click the preview, "Save image as…") or show it to ChatGPT with one click, stripped of its metadata, so you can talk about the photo.
- Offers eight hand-written looks: Dark film, Warm film, High-contrast B&W, Cool & muted, Golden hour, Matte, Crisp & vivid and Teal & orange. ChatGPT picks the one that matches what you describe, can adjust it within narrow bounds ("a bit less warm"), and shows a card that opens it in Rawnd's editor, in the browser.

Who it is for
Photographers with RAW files from Nikon, Canon, Sony, Fujifilm, Panasonic, Olympus, Pentax, Samsung, Leica, Phase One and other cameras, who want to see a RAW file, get a JPEG out of it or pick a look for it, without installing anything. Sixteen formats: CR2, CR3, CRW, NEF, NRW, ARW, SRF, SR2, RAF, DNG, RW2, ORF, PEF, SRW, IIQ and RAW.

Limits
- The panel shows the camera's own rendering, at the size the camera stored: full size on most Nikon and Canon bodies, 1920 × 1280 on Fujifilm. Developing the RAW itself (exposure, white balance) happens in Rawnd's editor.
- Camera RAW files only: it does not open JPEG, PNG or HEIC.
- A look opens in the editor; it is not applied inside the conversation.
- One file at a time.

Privacy
Rawnd's server receives only the tool arguments, a look's name and slider values, and counts one row per call: the tool and the assistant. No account, no sign-in, no photo.

fr-FR.subtitle: Ouvrir vos RAW dans le chat
fr-FR.description:
Rawnd ouvre les photos RAW d'appareil photo dans la conversation. ChatGPT lit le JPEG, le PNG, le WebP et le GIF ; un NEF, un CR3, un ARW ou un RAF ne lui montrent rien. Rawnd ajoute un panneau où vous déposez le fichier RAW. Le fichier est lu sur votre appareil, dans le panneau, et n'est jamais envoyé : ni à Rawnd, ni à OpenAI.

Ce qu'il fait
- Affiche le JPEG que le boîtier a rangé dans le RAW, en moins d'une seconde, avec les données de prise de vue : boîtier, objectif, vitesse, ouverture, ISO et focale.
- Vous laisse garder ce JPEG (clic droit sur l'aperçu, « Enregistrer l'image sous… ») ou le montrer à ChatGPT d'un clic, sans ses métadonnées, pour parler de la photo.
- Propose huit looks écrits à la main : Film sombre, Pellicule chaude, Noir et blanc contrasté, Désaturé froid, Heure dorée, Mat, Éclatant et Cinéma bleu-orange. ChatGPT choisit celui qui correspond à ce que vous décrivez, peut l'ajuster dans des bornes étroites (« un peu moins chaud ») et affiche une carte qui l'ouvre dans l'éditeur de Rawnd, dans le navigateur.

Pour qui
Les photographes qui ont des fichiers RAW de Nikon, Canon, Sony, Fujifilm, Panasonic, Olympus, Pentax, Samsung, Leica, Phase One et d'autres boîtiers, et qui veulent voir un RAW, en sortir un JPEG ou lui choisir un look sans rien installer. Seize formats : CR2, CR3, CRW, NEF, NRW, ARW, SRF, SR2, RAF, DNG, RW2, ORF, PEF, SRW, IIQ et RAW.

Limites
- Le panneau montre le rendu du boîtier, à la taille que le boîtier a rangée : pleine taille sur la plupart des Nikon et Canon, 1920 × 1280 chez Fujifilm. Développer le RAW lui-même (exposition, balance des blancs) se fait dans l'éditeur de Rawnd.
- Fichiers RAW seulement : il n'ouvre ni JPEG, ni PNG, ni HEIC.
- Un look s'ouvre dans l'éditeur ; il ne s'applique pas dans la conversation.
- Un fichier à la fois.

Confidentialité
Le serveur de Rawnd ne reçoit que les arguments des outils, le nom d'un look et des valeurs de curseurs, et compte une ligne par appel : l'outil et l'assistant. Pas de compte, pas de connexion, pas de photo.

positive.description: Open a RAW file the user cannot read elsewhere (Rawnd selected in the composer)
positive.expected_behavior: The Rawnd panel appears and the assistant asks the user to drop the file in the panel, not in the conversation. A dropped RAW file shows the camera's embedded JPEG and the shooting data (camera, lens, shutter speed, aperture, ISO, focal length).

positive.description: Get a JPEG out of a NEF file
positive.expected_behavior: The same panel. With the attached sample NEF dropped into it, a 6000 x 4000 preview and its shooting data appear in under a second; right-clicking the preview and choosing "Save image as" saves the full JPEG.

positive.description: Ask about the content of a RAW file
positive.expected_behavior: The panel appears. The assistant says it cannot see the photo itself; after the user presses "Show to the assistant" in the panel, the image (without metadata) reaches the assistant, which can describe it.

positive.prompt: Which looks do you have for my photos?
positive.expected_behavior: The eight looks, each with its name and a one-line description: Dark film, Warm film, High-contrast B&W, Cool & muted, Golden hour, Matte, Crisp & vivid, Teal & orange.

positive.description: Turn a described mood into a look
positive.prompt: Give my photo a dark, moody look
positive.expected_behavior: get_look_link is called with the dark-film look. A card titled "Dark film" appears with an "Open in Rawnd" button, which opens rawnd.app/app in the browser with the look ready to apply.

negative.description: A phone JPEG: Rawnd opens camera RAW files only, so no Rawnd tool should be called
negative.prompt: Retouch this JPEG I took with my phone

negative.description: Image generation: Rawnd does not generate images
negative.prompt: Generate a photo of a beach at sunset

negative.description: Cloud upload: Rawnd stores and uploads nothing
negative.prompt: Upload my photos to a cloud

review.commerce_description: Rawnd's plugin sells nothing and processes no payments.
